metadata.method: Manual static instruction/data-flow review grounded by matched public symbols, CodeView member/virtual-slot metadata and PE imports. No execution of the reference binary.
metadata.limits: These are bounded contracts, not a claim that all packet semantics, indirect listeners, physics, resource behavior or server anticheat compatibility were reproduced. No send observed in a reviewed body is not proof that every transitive callback cannot send.

external_references.use: Documents the API to which the matched executable passes the signed loop count unchanged.

external_references.topic: Old sound-update duplicate variant binding and later replacement

scope: Per-variant out-of-range discriminator check in the matched2193 normal binary reader; outer error recovery and disconnect policy remain unresolved.

reader_path.note: The binary-format flag selects the index-based helper. Compression is enabled temporarily for the additional uint32 value.

error_path.message: Invalid element index: likely data corruption
error_path.observed_effect: Appends a context error and returns from this helper without narrowing the invalid index or calling an alternative reader.

implication: Every repeated event has the same range check. Index256 is invalid; truncating it to current uint8 Stop0 before validation creates an unsupported valid operation.
limits: This finding does not establish all outer context rollback, continued-field parsing, packet failure, or disconnect behavior.
Successful parsing of a later repetition is not used here to claim that an earlier error is erased or retained by every surrounding layer.
Behavior of mutually inconsistent but individually valid seven-event repetitions remains separately bounded.
